title: Implement full ChatToolCatalog: source_bundle, task/memory write tools, code search tools
description:
The current ChatToolCatalog only has 10 tools. The existing test suite (ChatToolCatalogAndInterceptTests.cs) expects 20+ tools including source_bundle, find_by_source, task_create/update/set_status/add_comment/add_attachment, memory_create/update, code_search, code_search_status, code_search_merge_shard, task_list, task_get. These tests were written ahead of the catalog implementation and are currently failing.

### Tools to add

**SensitiveRead (EnabledByDefaultInMcp=false):**
- memorysmith_source_bundle — read source file content for source-linked memories
- memorysmith_find_by_source — back-map a source path to KB entries that reference it

**ReadOnly (EnabledByDefaultInMcp=true):**
- memorysmith_code_search — search indexed codebase chunks
- memorysmith_code_search_status — get current code index build status
- memorysmith_task_list — list/filter task records
- memorysmith_task_get — fetch a specific task by ID

**Write (EnabledByDefaultInMcp=false, AvailableInAgent=true — for future AgentTools):**
- memorysmith_task_create — create a new task
- memorysmith_task_update — update task fields
- memorysmith_task_set_status — change task status
- memorysmith_task_add_comment — add a comment to a task
- memorysmith_task_add_attachment — add an attachment to a task
- memorysmith_memory_create — create a new memory record
- memorysmith_memory_update — update an existing memory record

**Write (EnabledByDefaultInMcp=false, AvailableInAgent=false):**
- memorysmith_code_search_merge_shard — merge a code search shard into the main index

### Acceptance criteria
- All tests in ChatToolCatalogAndInterceptTests.cs pass
- ChatToolCatalog_DefaultsSensitiveAndWriteMcpToolsOff passes
- ChatToolCatalog_ExposesWriteToolsOnlyToAgentMode passes (AgentTools includes task/memory write tools)
- McpController tool list and governance match the expanded catalog
- PR #53's AgentSessionService.AgentTools filter (AvailableInChat) still excludes write tools correctly

comments.author: council-review
comments.body: Pre-existing test failures: ChatToolCatalogAndInterceptTests.ChatToolCatalog_ExposesAllExpectedChatTools, ChatToolCatalog_ExposesWriteToolsOnlyToAgentMode, ChatToolCatalog_DefaultsSensitiveAndWriteMcpToolsOff all fail on master because the catalog only has 10 tools. These failures predate PR #53.
